assertions.name: N3_beats_100x_experimental_target
assertions.source: At N=3 (c_3 = J_Hopf(q=1) = -2 near-match) the Q_β residual is +6.0 ppb < 7.8 ppb (100× experimental target). The c_3 near-match status (q₀-dependent) is a SEPARATE fact from the experimental match — both reported, neither suppressed.

description: Canonical reference framing the Q_β precision ladder as a TRUNCATION ORDER of a convergent series Q_β = Q_base·Π(1+c_k·u^k), u = b·ℏ_q² ≈ 0.00852. Establishes the N(ε) formula (N ≥ log10(1/ε)/2.07 − 1), per-rung term sizes, the q₀-stability floor diagnosis (c_k≥3 are q₀-dependent near-matches, not Taylor-exact), and the Habiro-element fix (parallel α_EM #1511). Written to stop the recurring c_k wire/un-wire flip-flop by separating 'N = truncation order chosen by precision' from 'c_k canonicity tier (proved/near-match/fitted)'.

data.non_monotonicity_note: N=4 residual (+0.055 ppb) is better than N=5 (+0.63 ppb). A convergent series with EXACT c_k would be monotone; the reversal is the signature that c_k≥3 are q₀-dependent near-matches.

q0_stability_floor.verdict: c_3=-2 is a STRUCTURAL NEAR-MATCH (q₀-dependent), not Taylor-exact. >>compute-precision swing ⟹ form-fitting.

data.habiro_fix: Identify the Q_β Habiro element (q-series whose Taylor coefficients ARE the c_k), parallel to the α_EM Habiro element [2]_q·(1-h²α) (PR #1511). Then c_k become exact + q₀-independent and |c_{N+1}·u^{N+1}| is a rigorous truncation bound.

canonical_framing.rule_1: N is a truncation order chosen by target precision, not a binary canonicity gate.
canonical_framing.rule_3: c_2 PROVED Taylor-exact; c_k≥3 are q₀-dependent near-matches until a Q_β Habiro element makes them exact.
canonical_framing.rule_4: Report TIERED (proved/near-match/fitted), never binary wired/dropped. N=3 beats 100× experimental with c_3 tagged near-match — both facts true.
